prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: square 1024 by 1024 pixel RGBA foliage-card texture atlas for a game. Generate ONE entirely NEW image containing precisely FOUR separate foliage CLUMPS of the one specified species, arranged in an invisible 2 by 2 grid. This is one texture atlas, not a presentation or contact sheet.
Background: genuine PNG transparency (real alpha channel). Every pixel outside the foliage must be transparent, including holes between leaves and the empty grid gutters. No white, gray, black, colored or checkerboard backdrop rendered into the image. No tabletop, ground, paper or border.
Layout: one naturally irregular compact foliage clump centered in EACH of the four quadrants. Centers approximately (256,256), (768,256), (256,768), (768,768) on the 1024-square canvas. Each clump fits inside a roughly 380 by 380 pixel area, with a generous transparent safety margin at every outer edge and a wide uninterrupted transparent cross-shaped gutter between quadrants. All four clumps completely disconnected; do not bridge them with stems or stray leaves. Each clump contains multiple overlapping small leaf sprays or leaf groups, not just one isolated leaf. Natural variation within the same species; similar scale and density.
References: the two supplied palace overview pictures guide foliage color and natural appearance ONLY. Do not reproduce any building, person, tree trunk, ground, horizon, text, shadows or sunlight from the reference pictures.
Style: convincingly photographic botanical foliage detail, naturally varied organic leaf edges and fine texture. Flat front-facing foliage for a card, readable at game scale; no painterly texture, no decorative illustration, no wax/plastic or repeating procedural pattern.
Color and lighting: DARK richly saturated forest green throughout, with subtle mid-green variation. No lime green, yellow-green highlights, pale tips or yellow leaves. Soft evenly distributed neutral diffuse light. No cast shadow, no ambient-occlusion blob, no black shadow behind the foliage, no sun glints, no shading or shadow painted outside leaves. Natural local detail on leaf surfaces only.
Foliage ONLY: no branches, no woody stems, no bark, no twigs, no trunk, no sticks, no roots. No flowers, berries, cones, pots or added objects. No labels, numbers, lettering, measurements, grid lines, frames or watermarks. Keep naturally transparent gaps and crisp antialiased alpha edges without a light halo.

Foliage subject: oriental arborvitae Platycladus orientalis. Four distinct compact clumps made of several overlapping, fine, flattened fan-like sprays of tiny scale leaves. Mature dark-green foliage with irregular finely divided fan silhouettes. Leaves and green foliage surfaces only, no visible supporting woody branches. Avoid broad deciduous leaves or long pine needles.
